            yang brang ti nas <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4261">'chims brtson seng</rs> | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:">rgyang ro dar ma mgon</rs> | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4251"/>mchims brtson rgyal | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:7767"/> shong blo brtan | lo tsA ba mchog ldan | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4097"/>dpang lo tsA ba | byang rtse | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:6741"/>nya dbon po kun dga' dpal | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:"/>chos dpal mgon po | bdag nyid chen po blo gros rgya mtsho'i bar ro || 
            yang | ko bo ye shes 'byung gnas | 'ban | tho gar ba gcam lde | 'jad pa byang skyabs | 'jad pa gzhon byang | 'bring mtshams zhang | bo dong rin rtse | khro phu rin po che bsod nams seng ge | tshad ma'i skyes bu | bu ston rin po che | mkhan chen dharma shrI | 
            des dbus su sde snod 'dzin pa mang po la gsungs so ||</seg></TEI>
